name: tdata
description: TData tournament admin hub: search tournaments, import matches, map teams, and send schedules to admin APIs.

scripts.build: prisma generate --schema backend/prisma/schema.prisma && next build frontend
scripts.test:tline:coverage: tsx --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=backend/src/tline/admin/directory.ts --test-coverage-include=backend/src/tline/domain/** --test-coverage-include=backend/src/tline/mappings/** --test-coverage-include=backend/src/tline/comparison/** --test-coverage-include=backend/src/tline/sources/** --test-coverage-include=backend/src/tline/application/runs.ts --test-coverage-include=backend/src/tline/application/scheduleState.ts --test-coverage-include=backend/src/tline/application/manualDecisions.ts --test-coverage-include=backend/src/tline/application/executor.ts --test-coverage-lines=80 --test-coverage-functions=80 --test-coverage-branches=80 tests/tlineAdminDirectory.test.ts tests/tlineManualMappings.test.ts tests/tlineDomainComparison.test.ts tests/tlineDomainMappings.test.ts tests/tlineDomainSources.test.ts tests/tlineApplicationRuns.test.ts tests/tlineApplicationState.test.ts tests/tlineApiParsers.test.ts tests/tlineExecutor.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:db && npm run test:e2e:prod
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run prisma:generate && npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run db:seed
